title: Make HTTPBase __call__ sync

### Commit to Help

- [X] I commit to help with one of those options 👆

### Example Code

```python
def set_log_attributes(
    request: Request | WebSocket, attrs: dict[str, Any]
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(request, Request):
        return attrs
    ...
    credentials = http_bearer(request)
    auth_session = authenticator(credentials=credentials)
    if auth_session.user_id:
        attrs["user_id"] = auth_session.user_id
    return attrs

logfire.instrument_fastapi(
    app, capture_headers=False, request_attributes_mapper=set_log_attributes
)
```


### Description

What is the reason to have HTTPBase and derived classes __call__ method async?

https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/blob/master/fastapi/security/http.py

My motivation is that I'm using logfire with fastapi integration that has custom function as `request_attributes_mapper`
https://github.com/pydantic/logfire/blob/d3682562f08344537ec9114f47f52631c2b6b364/logfire/_internal/main.py#L1012

Inside this function, I'd like to use my security_scheme as 
```
bearer_security = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False)
```
to retrieve credentials and after - the user_id
but because of async nature I need to make async function synchronous

macOS

answer.body:
Hello @gurobokum,

> What is the reason to have HTTPBase and derived classes call method async?

Fastapi is an asynchronous framework, all subclasses of `HTTPBase ` can be used as dependency and for this reason they are async. Each not async dependency is executed in a separated thread to avoid blocking the main loop, so make it sync, would be only inefficient.

About your case: since logfire for fastapi is based on [OpenTelemetry FastAPI Instrumentation](https://opentelemetry-python-contrib.readthedocs.io/en/latest/instrumentation/fastapi/fastapi.html) would be better to attach the user info to the request or a span and read them from there instead of reprocessing the header twice.
